shared_elements: low-relief figures aligned along a single ground line
a band of small repeated signs/ornament running along the bottom
figures whose arms extend forward toward something
justification: Both show profile human figures in shallow relief standing on a single ground line with a bottom register of small repeated signs, and in both cases the figures reach forward with their arms toward the object of the scene. But the content differs fundamentally: A is a procession of attendants leading two large horned rams, while B is a worship/offering scene centred on a rayed disc above an offering table with no animals at all.
